views.purpose: The Deployment / Allocation View uses deployable artifacts, execution nodes, and datastores to answer how the system is deployed, where application and data are executed and stored, and the runtime communication and dependencies between the application and database.
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can clearly show deployment nodes, execution environments, and runtime dependencies between application artifacts and databases.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: allocation-deployment, context, cnc-runtime

The context view was rejected because it focuses on high-level system boundaries and actors rather than physical execution environments and deployment artifacts. The cnc-runtime view was rejected because it focuses on component connectors rather than hardware/software allocation and deployment topology.
diagram language plantuml: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can clearly show deployment nodes, execution environments, and runtime dependencies between application artifacts and databases.
